# 🚀 Cosmic Candy Crusher

## 🎮 How to Play
1. Use arrow keys to move your spaceship
2. Press SPACEBAR to shoot candy at incoming asteroids
3. Collect power-ups to upgrade your weapons
4. Survive all 10 waves to win!

## ⭐ Features
- 50+ colorful levels
- 12 unique candy weapons
- Boss battles every 3 waves
- Local multiplayer support

## 🍬 Scoring
- Destroy asteroids: +10 points
- Collect candy: +5 points
- Defeat bosses: +100 points
